source.title: How turbulent flows grow vorticity at a point

reported_scope.equations: Incompressible Navier-Stokes with spatially smooth, temporally white Gaussian forcing
reported_scope.method: Numerical and analytical instanton optimization for a prescribed pointwise vorticity target
reported_scope.symmetry: Axisymmetric flow and reflection symmetry in the axial direction are assumed
reported_scope.target: Large but finite vorticity; no finite-time blow-up result
reported_scope.reported_mechanism: At higher target values, axial vorticity pulses propagate and collide; simple squeezing/stretching is insufficient in the authors' optimized path
reported_scope.author_caveat: The largest-target scaling estimates are described as speculative and may change at higher targets.
reported_scope.reproducibility: No code link was found on the arXiv record during this check; computations and thresholds were not independently reproduced here.

relation_to_project.relevance: Mechanistic comparison for vortex filament, stretching, and pulse dynamics discussed in the OpenAI construction.
not_established: equivalence to the OpenAI singular solution
molecular alignment or deterministic molecular positions
relation_to_project.disposition: Record as a scoped literature lead; do not file a solver or OpenAI repository issue on this evidence.
